milestones.21: Strict predictable kernels and costly-copy diagnostics
milestones.23: Composable effect contracts and callback rows
milestones.24: Scoped storage and deterministic resource ownership
milestones.26: Tensor shapes and explicit IEEE policy
milestones.28: Affine quantities and language-native test contracts
milestones.31: Flagship: durable key-value store and query layer
milestones.33: Web services with a wasm UI
milestones.35: Flagship: freestanding kernel in the strict lane

64_strict_audio.note: 64 allocation-free fixed-buffer audio blocks; no hidden copy, detach or panic in the kernel.

65_reject_hidden_allocation.note: Reject dynamic allocation behind a no allocates signature.

66_reject_implicit_copy.note: Reject an implicit independent runtime-sized mutable copy.

expect.diagnostic: explicit cop|implicit cop|runtime-sized cop|implicit costly copy

67_reject_unproved_index.note: Reject indexing with unknown bounds rather than insert a panic (`$runtime_checks=false` until no traps is the default).

68_positive_divisors.note: Prove positive divisors and nonempty indexing through helpers and guards.

69_dependent_append.note: Carry returned index evidence across a mutable append and a search result.

70_reject_stale_fact.note: Reject stale index evidence after a length-changing place mutation (`$runtime_checks=false` until no traps is the default).

71_checked_proofs.note: Check and erase proof calls; retain transitive result facts at callers.

72_prototype_boundary.note: Prototype-deferred bounds become explicit runtime checks; checked code exports success facts.

73_place_effects.note: Translate reads/writes on place parameters through swapped arguments and sibling fields.

74_callback_rows.note: Forward nonlocal callback rows while remapping explicit place permissions.

75_reject_effect_violation.note: Reject a transitive external mutation inside no_effects.

76_arena_escape.note: Copies escaping nested allocator scopes survive reset and preserve independent aggregates.
76_arena_escape.open: Typed allocation capabilities and allocator exhaustion result contract remain provisional.

77_owner_cleanup.note: Move last-use owners and release actual resources exactly once on return, break and continue; do not assert elidable copy-hook counts.

78_reject_resource_copy.note: Reject copying a drop-only owner while its original remains live.

79_scoped_byte_loan.note: Read scoped bytes, reserve and commit writable bytes, preserve snapshots after detach.

80_reject_loan_escape.note: Reject a raw address returned from a scoped storage loan.

81_partition_join.note: Fork owned disjoint partitions, join in source order, and prove coverage including an uneven tail.
81_partition_join.open: Scoped fork-join, partition proof syntax and scheduler context are unspecified; sequential value projection only.

82_overlap_race.note: Compile-time reject concurrent writes to overlapping ranges; accept adjacent partitions.
82_overlap_race.open: No task/partition spelling exists to encode the rejected concurrent source. This source is the deterministic overlap oracle, not a negative compiler test. Pending rejection: overlapping mutable task partitions.

83_transfer_properties.note: Derive structural task-transfer properties; reject an Rc-like non-atomic handle crossing tasks.
83_transfer_properties.open: Send/Sync spelling and negative assertion API are open; this only tests owned-message value behavior. Rc/Arc APIs cannot be invented. Pending rejection: value cannot cross a task boundary because its non-atomic shared owner is not transferable.

84_tensor_broadcast.note: Contiguous rank-2 arrays, row/column broadcast, transpose, snapshot rows, and reject mismatched shapes.
84_tensor_broadcast.open: General multidimensional literals/types, axis broadcasting and view layout are provisional; flat Matrix is an algorithm projection, not the tensor feature.

85_ieee_policy.note: IEEE signed zero, subnormal, overflow/underflow, NaN comparisons and deterministic reduction under an explicit policy.
85_ieee_policy.open: Formats, literals/conversions, NaN/Inf/divide-by-zero behavior, promotion, FMA and reduction policy need decisions. Exact controls do not satisfy IEEE acceptance.

86_exact_energy.note: Exact irregular energy integration, decimal tariffs, split invariance and denominator growth.

87_big_arithmetic.note: Runtime bigint modular exponentiation, 100!, binomial exact division and big rational intermediates; arithmetic only, no cryptographic security claim.

88_temperature_points.note: Temperature point-minus-point and point-plus-delta, exact C/F/K conversions and requested display units.
88_temperature_points.open: Offset scale declarations and point/delta arithmetic are provisional; display-unit selection x as km is provisional. Wrappers are exact controls only.

89_test_contracts.note: Discover 10 case-expanded tests, report one failed helper expectation, continue the test and retain ordinary main.

90_stack_repl.note: Interactive stdin RPN interpreter: variables, arithmetic, rollback on parse/stack/divisor errors, EOF and quit; bounded integer parser.

91_adventure_state.note: Command-driven adventure with inventory, locked transitions, score, win state and copied save states.

92_http_json_routes.note: HTTP/1.1 request parser and JSON integer-schema CRUD routing with status codes and transactional validation; deterministic transport transcripts.
92_http_json_routes.open: Portable socket/listen/accept, request framing limits and host capability APIs are unspecified. This tests the API handler, not a listening network server.

93_table_queries.note: SQLite-like in-memory table, parsed insert/update/delete/select, primary keys, ordered queries and begin/commit/rollback; independent SQLite oracle.

94_physics_hash.note: 80 integer-step 2D physics frames, spatial hash broad phase cross-checked against all pairs, deterministic axis impulses, walls, conserved kinetic sum and saved world.

95_kv_store.note: Durable ordered key-value store in modules: B+ tree index, checksummed write-ahead log with atomic multi-key transactions, recovery of torn and damaged tails, two-slot manifest, crash-safe compaction, SQL subset with a key-range planner; SQLite-checked session and a seeded crash-injection workload against a model.

96_ct_crypto.note: SHA-256/HMAC/HKDF, ChaCha20, Poly1305, (X)ChaCha20-Poly1305, X25519 and a replay-protected channel in modules, written without secret-dependent branches or indexing; FIPS 180-4, RFC 4231/5869/8439/7748 and XChaCha vectors, forgery and replay rejection, key-agreement-plus-AEAD workload. Constant time is not compiler-checked.

97_notes_service.note: Notes web service and UI (tier-4 flagship): HTTP/1.1 byte framing with limits, chunked bodies and pipelining; JSON CRUD with validation, revisions, conditional requests, atomic batches and static files; a UI state machine over the same wire bytes. Also runs as wasm (tests/test_flagship_web.py).

98_notes_listen.note: The notes service of 97 behind a real loopback listener (accept, partial reads, pipelining, close, EOF) plus the wasm page shell (ui_app.dewy, built by tests/test_flagship_web.py) that talks to it over WebSocket.
98_notes_listen.open: 12: portable socket listen/accept, host capabilities and a web fetch/socket surface are unspecified; this uses the implementation library net.

99_dewy_frontend.note: Dewy's own lexer and Pratt parser (ported from compiler/dewy_fast.jo) as Dewy modules: token and syntax-tree dumps for a 53-entry corpus, with the frontend's diagnostics at line:column. Also runs as wasm.

100_rtos_kernel.note: RTOS kernel (tier-4 flagship) in $no_hidden_costs modules with & no allocates & no blocks entry points and no runtime checks: fixed TCBs, priority scheduling with FIFO turns and time slices, mutexes with transitive priority inheritance, bounded mailboxes with blocked senders/receivers, a hashed timer wheel, a LIFO block pool, a bump arena and maskable latched interrupt lines, driven by a stdin event script. Hosted simulation; the bare-metal image (a $target, extern timer and device pointers) is held on question 24.

101_ml_training.note: ML training loop (tier-4 flagship): a 2-12-12-3 ReLU perceptron trained with Adam on a seeded three-class XOR cloud, per-sample backpropagation in parallel with a fixed-order gradient reduction, per-epoch loss/accuracy, held-out confusion matrix and probes, matched bit for bit (printed) by an independent float oracle. core.dewy is the twin over arrays and parallel.
101_ml_training.open: 7: tensor syntax and broadcasting are unsettled; the design uses whole-batch matrix products, new axes, dotted broadcasting, index-array row gathers, rank-1 tensors, [a b; c d] literals and .to(device) placement.
